headline: ICICI Securities issues a buy rating on Eternal
hook: Broker issues buy call on Eternal
summary: ICICI Securities has released a brokerage note with a buy recommendation on Eternal. The brief market note indicates positive outlook from the brokerage firm. Retail investors should review the underlying fundamentals before acting on broker recommendations.
why_it_matters: Brokerage recommendations may drive short-term retail trading volume

headline: Eternal overtakes TCS in Nifty 50 weightage
hook: Quick-commerce startup overtakes IT giant in Nifty
summary: Eternal has surpassed Tata Consultancy Services in Nifty 50 index weightage following recent market movements. This shift reflects the rapid valuation growth of the quick-commerce sector compared to traditional IT services. The change impacts index-tracking funds and ETFs that must rebalance their holdings to match the new weightings. Retail investors holding Nifty 50 index funds will see their portfolio exposure shift toward the quick-commerce entity.
why_it_matters: Index funds will automatically adjust holdings to match new weightings.

headline: Zomato parent Eternal surpasses TCS in Nifty 50 weightage
hook: High-growth tech overtakes legacy IT giants
summary: Eternal now holds a higher weight in the Nifty 50 index compared to Tata Consultancy Services. This shift is driven by the index's market capitalization methodology, which emphasizes free-float shares. Passive funds are consequently adjusting their portfolios to allocate more capital toward growth-oriented stocks like Eternal. Indian retail investors tracking index funds will see greater exposure to consumer tech relative to traditional IT.
why_it_matters: Index funds shift more capital into growth tech over IT.
winners_losers: Eternal holders gain / legacy IT holders see reduced passive inflows
